solution.text:
When AgCl is dissolved in excess of each of NH3, KCN and Na2S2O3 separately, the complex ions produced in each case are AgNH32+,AgCN2-, and AgS2O323- respectively as follows
AgCl+2NH4OH→AgNH32Cl+2H2O
AgCl+2KCN→KAgCN2+KCl
